title: 只是想你了
status: 第一段副歌 Shorts 已合成，672×1216，未超分
coreStatement: 这是一首写给深夜独自到家、仍想着某个人却不打算打扰的人，关于没开灯的房间里那句不必抱歉的想念，希望听众感到克制也可以是温柔，并记住「只是想你了」。

metadata.mood: 克制、安静、深夜思念、不道歉
metadata.vocal: 中文第一人称；本片沿用《比永远差一天》女主脸，录音棚戴耳机演唱第一段副歌

characterLooks.label: 男主三视图共享提示词

mvStory.summary: 第一段副歌的竖屏短片：女主独自戴着耳机站在录音棚里，把「只是想你了」唱进麦克风，不发给任何人。
mvStory.opening: 她已经戴好黑色头戴耳机，靠近银色电容麦，对着防喷罩唱出第一句「只是想你了」。
mvStory.development: 同一棚内，右手轻触耳罩，把想念唱得更近，仍只有她一个人。
mvStory.turningPoint: 「在这个无声的瞬间」，棚里安静下来，她把话留给麦克风，而不是留给对方的手机。
mvStory.climax: 「不需要任何抱歉」时胸腔略打开，表情仍克制，不控诉、不求救。
mvStory.ending: 最后一句「想你了」之后她不摘耳机、不离开麦克风，这句话停在棚里。

[Shot 1] A new eye-level medium close-up. The camera sits slightly to her right, both eyes visible, never a hard profile. Frame from the upper chest to a little space above the headphones. The camera holds a static shot. Her head stays still. Same black off-shoulder ribbed top, same long black hair, same black over-ear headphones. The same silver condenser microphone now stands on screen left, hung high: the capsule and the shock mount sit in the upper part of the frame, beside her temple, close to the top edge. Only the one round black pop filter reaches mouth height, mounted in front of the grille, with empty air before her lips. Both lips, the philtrum and the chin stay fully uncovered. She sings in lip-sync to <Audio 1> until the last 想你了 is finished, both hands down. In the final second, two fingers of the hand on the side away from the microphone come to rest on that headphone cup and stay. The hand never crosses her mouth. She remains, gaze on the microphone. Stable face and hands, eyelids open, irises readable. One living person. No second microphone, no second filter, no new room, no on-screen text, no logos.
